items.title: Kyle Pitts: Scores first TD of season
items.description:
Pitts caught five of six targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Mark Andrews: Costly fumble in OT win
items.description:
Andrews caught four of six targets for 28 yards and lost a fumble in Sunday's 30-23 overtime win over the Falcons.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tua Tagovailoa: Picked off in OT after Penix injury
items.description:
Tagovailoa completed two of three passes for 34 yards and an interception in relief of Michael Penix (ribs) in Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyler Huntley: Three total TDs in comeback OT win
items.description:
Huntley completed 24 of 32 passes for 201 yards and two touchdowns while rushing six times for 20 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-23 overtime win over the Falcons.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Zay Flowers: Eight catches from Huntley in OT win
items.description:
Flowers (foot) caught eight of nine targets for 53 yards and added a 13-yard rush in Sunday's 30-23 overtime win over the Falcons.
